newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian inflation slows to 0.8 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian inflation slows to 0.8 pct in June.

text.p: Bulgaria's monthly consumer price inflation slowed to 0.8 percent in June from 5.6 percent in May, the National Statistics Institute (NSI) said on Thursday.
Cumulative inflation for the first six months was 484.2 percent.
A year on year inflation figure for June will be available later this month.
BULGARIAN CONSUMER PRICES JUNE MAY JUNE'96
Prices of potatoes fell by 37.3 percent month on month in by 21.9 percent and bread fell by four percent.
Cooking oil rose by 37.7 percent and meat rose by 12.2 percent.
Consumer price inflation for 1997 was assumed at 566 percent in this year's draft budget. Annual inflation for 1996 was 310.8 percent.

Inflation projections were made under a fixed exchange rate of 1,000 levs per mark, introduced on July 1 along with a currency board arrangement recommended by the International Monetary Fund to stabilise the economy.
Inflation was expected to slow down under the currency board system as central bank lending to the government and commercial banks would be banned to prevent the printing of money.
